nodes.summary: On a normed space, the map $(u, \xi) \mapsto \sqrt{1 - \beta^2}\, u + \beta \xi$ is continuous (it is linear and bounded), so it is Borel measurable and its image laws are well defined.
nodes.title: Continuity of the pCN proposal map

nodes.summary: If $Q$ is a Markov kernel reversible for the prior probability measure $\mu_0$ and $\Phi$ is measurable, then the posterior $\mu \propto e^{-\Phi} \mu_0$ is invariant for the Metropolis–Hastings kernel $P$ with acceptance probability $\min\{1, e^{\Phi(u) - \Phi(v)}\}$: $\int P(u, B) \, \mu(du) = \mu(B)$ for every measurable $B$. It follows from reversibility, since a reversible Markov kernel leaves its measure…
nodes.title: The posterior is invariant for Metropolis–Hastings with a prior-reversible proposal

nodes.summary: If $u \sim N(0, C)$ and $\xi \sim N(0, C)$ are independent, then $\sqrt{1 - \beta^2}\, u + \beta \xi \sim N(0, C)$ for every $-1 \le \beta \le 1$, on any separable Banach space. This follows from reversibility, since a reversible Markov kernel leaves its measure invariant.
nodes.title: The pCN proposal preserves its Gaussian prior

nodes.summary: For a Markov proposal kernel $Q$ and a measurable potential $\Phi$, $P(u, \cdot)$ is a probability measure for every $u$: its total mass is $\int a \, dQ(u, \cdot) + \int (1 - a) \, dQ(u, \cdot) = 1$ because $a \le 1$.
nodes.title: The Metropolis–Hastings kernel is a Markov kernel

nodes.summary: Let $\mu_0$ be a probability measure, $Q$ a Markov kernel reversible with respect to $\mu_0$ and $\Phi$ measurable. Then the Metropolis–Hastings kernel with acceptance probability $a(u, v) = \min\{1, e^{\Phi(u) - \Phi(v)}\}$ satisfies detailed balance with respect to the posterior $\mu \propto e^{-\Phi} \mu_0$.
nodes.title: Metropolis–Hastings with a prior-reversible proposal is reversible for the posterior

nodes.title: Prior reversibility of the pCN proposal

nodes.summary: Let $\mu_0$ be a centred Gaussian measure on a separable Banach space, $-1 \le \beta \le 1$ and $\Phi$ measurable. The pCN method (propose $v = \sqrt{1 - \beta^2}\, u + \beta \xi$ with $\xi \sim \mu_0$, accept with probability $\min\{1, e^{\Phi(u) - \Phi(v)}\}$) satisfies detailed balance with respect to the posterior $\mu \propto e^{-\Phi} \mu_0$, and hence leaves it invariant.
nodes.title: The pCN method is reversible for the posterior

nodes.summary: If a Markov kernel $Q$ is reversible with respect to a finite measure $\mu_0$, then the joint law $\mu_0(du) \, Q(u, dv)$ on pairs is invariant under $(u, v) \mapsto (v, u)$. Detailed balance is this identity on rectangles $A \times B$; rectangles form a π-system generating the product σ-algebra.
nodes.title: Detailed balance makes the joint law symmetric

nodes.summary: Let $\mu_0$ be a centred Gaussian measure on a separable Banach space and $-1 \le \beta \le 1$. If $u \sim \mu_0$ and $\xi \sim \mu_0$ are independent and $v = \sqrt{1 - \beta^2}\, u + \beta \xi$, then $(u, v)$ and $(v, u)$ have the same law.
nodes.title: The joint law of a pCN step is symmetric

nodes.summary: If $\Phi$ is measurable, then $(u, v) \mapsto \min\{1, \exp(\Phi(u) - \Phi(v))\}$ is measurable on the product space, so the accepted part $a(u, v)\, Q(u, dv)$ of the Metropolis–Hastings kernel is a kernel.
nodes.title: Measurability of the acceptance probability

nodes.summary: On a separable normed space with its Borel σ-algebra, $(u, \xi) \mapsto \sqrt{1 - \beta^2}\, u + \beta \xi$ is measurable for the product σ-algebra, which is what the construction of the pCN kernel needs.
nodes.title: Measurability of the pCN proposal map

nodes.summary: For every potential $\Phi$ and all $u$, $v$, $a(u, v) = \min\{1, \exp(\Phi(u) - \Phi(v))\} \le 1$, so $1 - a(u, v)$ is a genuine rejection probability.
nodes.title: The acceptance probability is at most one

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
